end.summary:
Practised adding two-digit numbers without regrouping and with regrouping.
Added tens with tens and ones with ones in 24 + 13 = 37.
Explained that 10 ones make a bundle of 1 ten; later applied this to 4 + 8 = 12.
Still mixed up when to carry and could not complete the teach-back.
end.parentNote: Asha practised lining up tens and ones and using a bundle of 10 ones to make 1 new ten. Avni correctly explained the bundle idea for 4 + 8 = 12, but later mixed up when to carry in a two-digit sum, so the idea was not fully secure by the end. At home, use coins or small objects to make groups of 10 and practise one example such as 24 + 18, saying aloud, “12 ones makes 1 ten and 2 ones.”
